result.instructions: Tools for Searchanise, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which products match 'running shoes' in the size filter, cheapest first?"; "Is the latest product import indexed, and how many products are searchable?"; "What does the search suggest when a shopper types 'wireless'?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Searchanise data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run searchanise_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run searchanise_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run searchanise_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. searchanise_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: searchanise_search
tools.title: Search products, categories and pages
tools.description: Search the store's products with Searchanise, as the Search Results Widget does. Returns product ids, titles, links, prices, quantities and images; optionally matching categories and pages, and filter facets. restrict_by filters by attribute. For text attributes: | is OR, a comma is AND, ! is NOT, and a backslash escapes | or a comma (for example {"category": "Shoes|Boots"}). For number attributes, from,to is a range (for example {"price": "0,150"}). Search API: GET /getresults.

q.description: Search text, matched against all searchable attributes. Max 512 characters.

restrict_by.description: Filters by attribute name and value, for example {"price": "0,150"} for a price range. Attributes must be enabled for filtering in Searchanise.

sort_order.description: Sort order (default asc). Has no effect on relevance.

start_index.description: Offset of the first product (default 0). start_index plus max_results cannot exceed 100000.

include_facets.description: Also return filter facets (filter names and value counts).

tools.name: searchanise_autocomplete
tools.title: Get search suggestions
tools.description: Get what the Instant Search Widget shows while a shopper types: query suggestions, the top matching products, and optionally categories and pages. Search API: GET /getwidgets with suggestions=true.

q.description: The partial or full search text.

tools.name: searchanise_get_index_status
tools.title: Get index status
tools.description: Get the store's index state: status (none, update, updating, normal, error or disabled), full_import (start or done) and product_count. Use it to check whether the latest product data is indexed. State API: GET /api/state/get/json.

tools.name: searchanise_delete_product
tools.title: Delete a product from the search index
tools.description: Remove one product from the Searchanise search index by its numeric id. It does not delete the product from the store, and it cannot be undone from here (re-import the product to restore it). Searchanise applies the delete after indexing, which takes some minutes. The store's own catalog is not changed. Update API: POST /api/items/delete/json.

annotations.title: Delete a product from the search index
